def check(self, files_or_modules: Sequence[str] | str) -> None:
        """Main checking entry: check a list of files or modules from their name.

        files_or_modules is either a string or list of strings presenting modules to check.
        """
        self.initialize()
        if not isinstance(files_or_modules, (list, tuple)):
            # TODO: 3.0: Remove deprecated typing and update docstring
            warnings.warn(
                "In pylint 3.0, the checkers check function will only accept sequence of string",
                DeprecationWarning,
            )
            files_or_modules = (files_or_modules,)  # type: ignore[assignment]
        if self.config.recursive:
            files_or_modules = tuple(self._discover_files(files_or_modules))

repository_facts.statement: PyLinter.check expands the supplied targets through _discover_files when recursive configuration is enabled.
During recursive os.walk traversal, each directory root is checked against ignore names, ignore patterns, and self.config.ignore_paths; an ignored root is added to skipped subtrees.
Recursive discovery yields a directory when it contains __init__.py; otherwise it yields every filename ending in .py within that directory.
Discovered targets are subsequently passed to expand_modules with ignore names, ignore patterns, and the linter's stored ignore-path patterns.
The shared ignored-file predicate checks ignore names and basename patterns, then checks the complete element path against ignore-path patterns using regex match.
expand_modules discards an input target immediately when the shared ignored-file predicate matches it.
When expand_modules enumerates package or namespace submodules, it skips a subfile if its basename matches ignore-patterns or its full path matches ignore-paths.
The ignore-path transformer compiles each supplied pattern into alternatives representing Windows and Posix path forms.

@set_config(ignore_paths=".*/tests/.*,.*\\ignore\\.*")
    def test_ignore_paths_with_value(self) -> None:
        """Test ignore-paths option with value."""
        options = self.linter.config.ignore_paths

        assert any(i.match("dir/tests/file.py") for i in options)
        assert any(i.match("dir\\tests\\file.py") for i in options)
        assert any(i.match("dir/ignore/file.py") for i in options)
        assert any(i.match("dir\\ignore\\file.py") for i in options)

repository_facts.statement: A configuration unit test verifies that ignore-path patterns match both slash and backslash forms for tests and ignore directory paths.
